tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search events (festivals, exhibitions, performances, markets, pop-ups) in Shanghai and Hangzhou, China. Filter by city, category, date range, free entry or keyword. Dates are China Standard Time (UTC+8) and inclusive. Past events are excluded unless include_past is true. Every result has page_url: c

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details of a single event by id, as returned by search_events. Includes the Chinese title and venue, price text and last_verified date. Cite page_url when answering.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Returns the cities and categories this server covers, plus the date the data was last built. Call this first if unsure whether a city is supported.
